documents.title: Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By BSE Limited
Clarification sought from DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By NSE Limited.

analysis.summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited reported its Q4 FY26 and FY26 financial performance, highlighting top-line growth driven largely by raw material price increases rather than volume expansion or margin improvement. Management discussed severe disruptions in the sulfur supply chain caused by the Middle East crisis and Gulf of Hormuz transit issues, which impacted plant operations at Roha. Additionally, boron chemical operations faced supply and energy cost headwinds earlier in the year, and working capital requirements expanded significantly due to higher inventory and debtor values. Management reported a Q2 FY26 top line of INR 126 crores, flat sequentially but 25 percent higher year-on-year, alongside a profit before tax of INR 8.28 crores. Performance was negatively impacted by logistical challenges in the boron business due to a change in raw material suppliers and a reduction in European demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe continues to struggle, leading to a reduction in the company's specialty chemical business in that region.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to struggle. So, our speciality chemical business has reduced in Europe, but it is improving in other parts of the world.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for non-boric products was affected by a gas crisis impacting consuming centers like Morbi, creating a bearish sentiment due to a market glut.
demand_outlook.quote: So, what happened is that they stopped consuming whatever raw materials they had, they were selling into the market. And this resulted again in disruption in the market in terms of pricing and oversupply in terms of volume.

demand_outlook.claim: Sulfur continues to be in short supply, resulting in ever-increasing prices to all-time high levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Sulfur continues to be in short supply, which has resulted in ever-increasing prices to all-time high levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that consumption in Europe has declined due to internal issues and energy policies, leading to plant shutdowns rather than a loss of business to competition.
demand_outlook.quote: On the positive side, and that is not because of competition or anything, but it's more because the consumption in Europe has come down. We have not lost business to competition, but because of internal issues within Europe, including their energy policy and things like that, they have reduced their consumption. And in fact, a lot of the plants are shutting down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that overall business conditions have been better than the previous two years, with the major exception of the European markets struggling with increased energy costs and reduced chemical production and consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: And overall, the situation has been better than the previous 2 years with one major exception being the European markets. You all know how Europe has struggled with the increase in cost, particularly that of energy and several chemical companies have reduced their production in Europe, and there is really not much expansion happening.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the company has lost some exports to Europe not due to competition, but because local consumption of those materials in Europe has come down.
demand_outlook.quote: So we have lost some of our exports to Europe as well, not to competition, but basically the consumption of those materials in Europe has come down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted positive changes in domestic consumption in India, particularly in the boron business where they experienced good growth.
demand_outlook.quote: So apart from positive changes in the domestic consumption in India and particularly in the boron business where we have had some good growth, the export sales and that constitutes mostly Specialty Chemicals has taken a hit because of the EU market conditions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the boron business achieved about INR 100 crores in sales in the past year with good overall growth.
demand_outlook.quote: We had about INR 100 crores in sales for the boron business in the past year. And our -- most of our CAPEX investment has been done.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that all major planned investments have been made and they are not envisaging any major capital expenditure at this time.
capex_expansion.quote: And all our major investments that we had planned have been made. So we are not envisaging any major CAPEX at this time.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they have a plan for capital expenditure of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to the Dahej expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We have a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to what we have done, the major expansion at Dahej, which happened over the last few years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that for the boron business, most capital investment is done and only incremental investment or debottlenecking is planned without substantial capital expenditure needed.
capex_expansion.quote: And our -- most of our CAPEX investment has been done. So what we will do is incremental investment or debottlenecking, that kind of thing. No substantial CAPEX needed.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental working capital lines were drawn at an interest rate ranging between 8.75% and 9%.
margins_costs.quote: So, it's about 9%, 8.75% to 9% in that range is the percentage of interest.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur inventory is normally kept at a maximum of 15 days at each location.
margins_costs.quote: Sulfur inventory is normally not more than 15-20 days at each location. So, it's about 1,500 tons at each location.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur costs have risen for all consumers and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.
margins_costs.quote: Sulfur costs have gone up, not only for us, but for all consumers of sulfur and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the full financial year EBITDA margins were about 13.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the full year, we've had EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that Q4 of the previous year included a pre-tax profit of about INR 8 crores on the sale of some investments, which needs to be factored into comparisons.
margins_costs.quote: If you compare it to the previous year, it may not seem much of an increase, but I just point out that in the last year and particularly Q4 of last year, we had a profit on the sale of some investments, which was to the tune of about INR 8 crores before tax. So that needs to be factored in when you are comparing last quarter -- the same quarter of last year with this year's Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: Both manufacturing plants at Dahej and Roha have a very similar installed capacity of 350 tons per day.
The commodity business operates at between 95% and 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our commodity business, which is sulfuric acid and allied products that operates at more than 90% capacity, I would say, between 95% to 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The specialty chemical business is operating at or slightly below 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The specialty chemical business is at or maybe slightly below 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization in the Specialty Chemicals business is between 50% to 60% on average.
orders_capacity.quote: I would say we are between 50% to 60% in our Specialty Chemicals business in terms of capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the bulk chemicals plants are practically running at full capacity, operating at 90% or 95% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So in the bulk chemicals, we are practically running at full capacity. So even last year, we would have run at 90% or 95% capacity. And that continues in this year as well.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that there is sufficient reactor capacity and space available within existing plants to double current sales of Specialty Chemicals.
orders_capacity.quote: And in terms of reactor capacity, etc, we are available sufficient to double our current sales of Specialty Chemicals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has reduced its debt and intends to continue doing so.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debt, as you can probably see from the balance sheet, and we will continue to do so.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements will increase to fund the extra needs of the boron business.
capital_allocation.quote: We will need more working capital. We have already arranged that with our bankers, and they are supporting us.

risks_headwinds.claim: About 50% of global sulfur trade flows through the Gulf of Hormuz, and disruptions there affected availability and prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Most of the sulfur traded flows through the Gulf of Hormuz. In fact, about 50% of global sulfur trade is through Hormuz. So that has affected availability and therefore the price of the product not only in India but also in other parts of the world including China.

risks_headwinds.claim: The first half of the year saw lost production in boron chemicals because of disruptions in the supply of boron ore from the main supplier in Turkey.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first half of the year, we lost a lot of production because of disruption in supply of the boron ore from our main supplier in Turkey.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Maharashtra government has not yet transferred the Nalimbi land parcel back to the company's name despite a Supreme Court verdict in their favor.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Maharashtra government has still not transferred the land back to our name in spite of the court order. So, we are not able to monetize it as yet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistical challenges on the boron business arose due to a change of distributor by the main supplier.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first instance, as I mentioned, logistical challenges on the boron business. You see there was a change of distributor by the main supplier of the boron raw materials and the previous supplier used to keep stock in India.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new boron distributor does not hold stock in India, pushing lead times up to nearly 90 to 100 days with required advance payments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now we have to buy ex-Turkey and pay advance before the material is shipped. So, that changes the time for arrival of the vessel by nearly 90 days to 100 days. And the new distributor took some time to set up the logistics. They still don't have any stock and no immediate plans to have stock in India.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management flagged that the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch is expected to put downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the potential threats to our profitability, as mentioned in the report, is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch, and that is expected to happen sometime later this year. Exact dates have not been announced. But that is expected to put some downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that at Dahej, the company lost 10 to 15 days of production out of a possible 90 days due to a plant shutdown spread across Q3 and Q4.
risks_headwinds.quote: At Dahej, we had a smaller shutdown because it was spread across a little bit a few days in the previous quarter, which is Q3 and about 10 days in Q4. So you could say we lost 10 to 15 days production out of possible 90 days production during that particular quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the Roha plant will have a slightly longer shutdown in Q1 of FY26 lasting about 20 days to 25 days total shutdown time.
risks_headwinds.quote: And we have a shutdown in Roha in Q1 of '25-'26, and that will be a slightly longer shutdown. That is about 20 days to 25 days total shutdown time. So the corresponding impact on production and sales will be seen.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company has plans for increasing R&D intensity, which will be visible in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But we do have some plans for increasing this, and you will see that in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The boron business is expected to recover and return to normal operations from the second half of Q3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And we look forward to the boron business recovering from the second half of the current quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that products recently launched are expected to get fully accepted in the current year, and new products will be developed for commercialization in the next year.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect that the products which we've recently launched will get fully accepted in this current year. And in this current year, we will develop some new products, which we'll take up in the next year for commercialization.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
